lines.speaker: Garden Man
lines.text: There is a child in the Thorn Verge who will not come out.

lines.speaker: Garden Woman
lines.text: We all learned to hide when love felt like possession.

lines.speaker: Junia
lines.text: Maybe someone needs to show that return is safe.

lines.speaker: Micah
lines.text: The Prayer Root on the upper path still remembers how gift was given freely.
